version.description: The version of this file format

enabled.description: false: the light does not follow the clock (always full day)

keyframes.description: The sky light at moments of the day, blended in time order and wrapping round midnight

anchor.description: sunrise or sunset: the keyframe sits at that hour of the season plus the offset

color.description: Red, green and blue of the sky light at this moment, each 0 to 255

strength.description: The ambient colour is multiplied by this

shadow.description: How dark shadows are at that moment, 0 to 1

sunPeakDegrees.description: How high the sun climbs at noon in each season, in degrees

Spring.description: How high the sun climbs at noon in spring, in degrees

Summer.description: How high the sun climbs at noon in summer, in degrees

Autumn.description: How high the sun climbs at noon in autumn, in degrees

Winter.description: How high the sun climbs at noon in winter, in degrees

moonPeakDegrees.description: How high the moon climbs, in degrees
